identity: Avatar features and warm painterly material preserved in every state.
idle: Visible blink and gentle head breathing; hands and shoes remain near rest.
gait: Right row has alternating contact/passing/flight poses, head/eyes face right; left framewise mirror faces left and preserves time order.
waving: Raised attached hand and tilt communicate greeting without marks.
jumping: Crouch, rise, peak, descent, settle. Shared row registration retains source vertical travel; baseline matches idle. All other rows receive one common per-row transform to match the jump resting height and reserve jump headroom.
failed: Eyebrows lift in worry, head slumps with closed eyes, recovers.
waiting: Both palms rise in an expectant question gesture.
running: Planted feet with busy hands and chin gestures indicate active thinking.
review: Head tilt, scanning eyes and hand at beard communicate inspection.
playback: Viewed ordered contact at native cell bounds; loops preserve body identity, planted ground, and intended airborne displacement. Per-state GIFs generated from assembled standard-row frames.
